But wait, in the final answer, they said the father-in-law was Theuderich I, but that doesn't make sense because Theuderich I is the same as Theuderic I, and the correct father is Clovis I. So, the mistake was in the last step where they confused Theuderich I with Clovis I. The step where they made the mistake was the final one, step 4. The reason was incorrect identification of the father-in-law as Theuderich instead of Clovis.
